// ABOUT: Go formatting with gofmt and goimports
// USAGE: Copy the PostToolUse section into your settings.json hooks. The matcher is the tool name (Edit|Write); the command guards on extension.

hooks.command: FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$FILE" in *.go) gofmt -w "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac

// WITH_GOIMPORTS: Use goimports for formatting + import management

PostToolUse_goimports.// DESCRIPTION: Format Go files with goimports (includes gofmt + import organization)

hooks.command: FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$FILE" in *.go) goimports -w "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac
FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$FILE" in *.go) goimports -w "$FILE" 2>/dev/null && golangci-lint run "$FILE" --fix 2>/dev/null || true;; esac
